title: Sagrada Família
text:
Isabel was one of the most outstanding tour guides we have ever had - her knowledge of the building of this masterpiece and all involved made seeing this with her exceptionally amazing !!! We will definitely book more tours with Isabel in the future - we also highly recommend going at the golden hour - it is the most beautiful time to see the reflections from the stained glass - 
The first photo is when we were inside around 5:10 pm and the second was at 6:08 pm
author: amyrH6642IO

title: Wonderful Tour
text:
The history symbolism and detail of the tour was exactly what we hoped for. Our guide was personable and put us at ease. She even helped me find a book that I wanted in the shop. Her name is 
Faidra.
author: Y6003NYcherylr

title: Majestic, Informative and breathless
text: Awe inspiring.an absolute must. Our guide Monste was delightful and well versed of the history and future of this majestic building. Photos would never do this tour or building justice.  Thank you Monste for bringing the Sagrada Familia to life for us.
author: OnAir59659129443

title: Majestic and informative
text: Awe inspiring.an absolute must. Our guide Monste was delightful and well versed of the history and future of this majestic building. Thank you.
author: Celina_T

title: Worth the moment in Time
text: Worth the moment in time! If you want the full experience of every color of the rainbow to understanding the story in front of you, this is a must! Our guide made the difference. This incredible place needs an explanation....don't miss this! Our guide was local and gave us some personal stories, which was extra special.
author: Jodi_W

title: The tour of Sagrada Famila is a must see for anyone visiting Barcelona.  And a private tour with Miguel Suarez Perez.
text: Our private tour sagrada família was amazing. Thanks to our guide Miguel Perez's knowledge and love for the history, architecture and region.   He was well worth the extra cost.
author: robertbR7798SL

title: Prepare to be enchanted
text: A magical experience the passion that our guide Miguel Suarez Perez has  for the history of the building and the city of Barcelona made the tour very memorable. This was a favorite of our trip.
author: JerryA1967

title: Golden Hour at 3pm? I think not.
text: This tour was sold as a "Golden Hour" tour and the time was changed to 3pm.  This was NOT the Golden hour.  It was stinking hot and filled with huge tour groups.  Viator did give us a personal guide (who was very good) to compensate for the change in time, but it was not enjoyable.
author: Glen_S
